neighbours.label: a possessive marker ('s, ', s) attached to a plural or group noun (women's, clientele', peoples', childrens)
fire: The conference focused on women's access to credit in rural areas.
The school changed the menu to improve children's diets.
Our design firm tries to meet the clients' many different needs.
The museum tells the story of the workers' long fight for a shorter day.
Researchers measured how the program changed farmers' incomes.
The council ignored the residents' complaints about the noise.
A new study looks at teenagers' sleep and screen time.
The charity defends migrants' rights in court every year.
quiet: The conference focused on access to credit for women in rural areas.
The school changed the menu to improve the diets of children.
Our design firm tries to meet the many different needs of clients.
The museum tells the story of the long fight for a shorter working day.
Researchers measured how the program changed incomes on the farms.
The council ignored complaints from residents about the noise.
A new study looks at sleep and screen time among teenagers.
The charity defends the rights of migrants in court every year.

notes: Card: peaks on '’s' x7, "'" x4, "'s" x4 after women, clientele, peoples, children; also Russian possessive endings. The + pole is possessive determiners before a possessed noun (your dog, his wife).
